name: Aerodrome Finance
gap: No investors and no presale (CoinMarketCap Academy; Blockworks transparency filing: 'No prior fundraising, OTC, or discounted MM sales'). Team/Foundation allocation (Blockworks: Foundation 19%/95M; CMC: team 14% locked 2-4 years; Bitrue: 'Development Team Funding (Auto Max-Locked): 95 million') was issued at launch as locked veAERO NFTs, not liquid AERO, and Blockworks says there are 'no token grants to individual contributors'. No source gives a date when insider veAERO locks expired or became liquid, so the first insider unlock date cannot be confirmed (null). Launch date itself conflicts: Bitrue says 2023-08-28, CMC Academy says 'August 29' (no year); outside the window either way. No single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating found: Bitrue states 'Aerodrome does not have a traditional cliff unlock event'; new supply comes from weekly emissions. Sources: https://medium.com/@aerodromefi/aerodrome-launch-tokenomics-30b546654a91 (primary), https://blockworks.com/token-transparency/filing/aerodrome (primary filing), https://www.bitrue.com/blog/aerodrome-finance-aero-token-unlock-details (aggregator), https://coinmarketcap.com/academy/article/what-is-aerodrome (aggregator).

name: ARK (ARK Ecosystem)
gap: Genesis block 2017-03-21 19:00 UTC per ARK's own press release (newswire.com, primary). The full genesis supply was created at launch: TEC press release (pressat.co.uk, primary) allocates 75% to crowdsale backers and reserves 15% ARK team, 7% ARK Shield, 2% bounties, 1% escrow; no source fetched mentions a team lockup or vesting, so team tokens are treated as received at genesis (atLaunch true). Not fully confirmed that the team share was transferable on day one. Supply figures disagree: TEC release says 125M generated, Coin Bureau says 100M at launch, and Coin Bureau also says 'launched in February 2017', which conflicts with the project's 2017-03-21 statement (project date used). After genesis, new supply comes only from block rewards (~10,800 ARK/day per Coin Bureau), so no single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating exists in the 2023-08-01 to 2025-11-16 window. Sources: https://www.newswire.com/news/ark-mainnet-goes-live-on-march-21-2017-token-distribution-to-follow-18989062 (primary), https://pressat.co.uk/releases/ark-crew-announces-official-ark-token-exchange-campaign-tec-559f29a13d5cc6587c9a398b73ac23f2 (primary), https://cryptobriefing.com/what-is-ark-introduction-ark-ecosystem-token/ (news), https://coinbureau.com/review/ark-coin (aggregator).

name: DeXe Protocol
gap: TGE 2020-10-19 (tokenomics.com). At TGE only the Public Sale (1.5%) and the Market Liquidity Fund (1%) were 100% unlocked. These are public buyers and a liquidity fund, not insiders, so TGE is not counted as an insider unlock. No private or VC round is listed. Team (20%) had a 6-month cliff and then 24 months linear (tokenomics.com). Tokenradar dates the team linear release Apr 18, 2021 - Apr 18, 2023, which puts the first insider unlock at ~2021-04-18, the start of a stream. That is outside the window. TGE + 6 months (~Apr 19-20) agrees within 2 days. No project vesting document was fetchable: dexe.network/sale-details is not on the allowlist, and the Binance Research page only links to it. In the window 2024-07-01 to 2025-11-16, the only scheduled release was the Foundation linear stream (tokenradar: Oct 20, 2021 - Oct 31, 2025). Tokenomics.com shows monthly 2025 events of ~0.8% of mcap each, the last on 2025-09-20, so there are no single-day unlocks of >=25% of circulating. Sources: https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/dexe (aggregator), https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/dexe/unlocks (aggregator), https://tokenradar.ai/tokens/dexe-protocol/tokenomics (aggregator).

name: Merlin Chain
gap: Token launch and trading started 2024-04-19 (Decrypt press release; OKX deposits from 2024-04-17). Tokenomics.com gives TGE as 2024-04-01 with 0% initial float. Merlin's own token post (Medium) shows no insider TGE unlock; only the Merlin's Seal airdrop (20%) and the Public Sale (1%) unlocked in month 1. Insider terms: Private Sale A (1.33%) 6-month cliff then 18 months vesting; Advisors (3%) 6-month cliff then 30 months; Private Sale B (13.90%) 12-month cliff then 36 months; Team (4.20%) 24-month cliff then 24 months. The first insider unlock is therefore the end of the Private Sale A / Advisors cliff, about 6 months after TGE. That is ~2024-10-19 if counted from the 2024-04-19 launch, and TradingView shows monthly unlocks on the 19th. No fetched page states the event's date or amount, so the date is null; it is inside the window. Every insider pool vests monthly after its cliff (shape: stream), and the largest pool, Private Sale B (291.9M over 36 months), works out to ~8M/month. TradingView puts total monthly unlocks around Nov 2024 - Apr 2025 at ~17.5M = ~2.08% of circulating. Tokenomics.com 2026 events are each <=3.2% of mcap. No single-day unlock of >=25% of circulating was found in 2024-04-01 to 2025-11-16. Sources: https://medium.com/@merlinchaincrypto/introducing-merlin-chain-token-merl-376fe43f180d (primary), https://decrypt.co/227157/merlin-chain-launches-merl-a-major-leap-forward-in-bitcoin-layer-2-solutions (news/press release), https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/merlin-chain/unlocks (aggregator), https://vn.tradingview.com/chart/MERLUSDT/Od2aLZKj-Merlin-Merl-all-you-have-to-know-is-its-UNLOCKS-MONEY (user post, low reliability).

name: Orderly Network
gap: TGE: airdrop claims opened 2024-08-26 08:00 UTC and CEX listings started 10:00 UTC (Coinspeaker); tokenomics.com says 2024-08-25. Orderly docs (primary): Strategic Investors (15%) are 'Locked for the first 6 months after TGE, followed by 3.5-year linear vesting'; Team & Advisors (20%) have a '1-year cliff (25% unlocks), followed by 3-year linear vesting'. No insider TGE unlock is stated; at TGE only the 133M retro airdrop and 38.5M Foundation liquidity were available. The first insider unlock is therefore the start of the investor linear stream around 2025-02-26, but no fetched page dates or sizes it, so the date is null; it is inside the window. Team/Advisors cliff: 25% x 200M = 50M lump about one year after TGE (~2025-08-26), not dated by any fetched page. CoinGecko research puts circulating at ~217M on 2025-01-01 and ~288M on 2025-08-31. 50M against roughly 230-290M circulating is ~17-22%, below 25% but not precisely measurable, so it is not listed as a B event; recheck if exact circulating on 2025-08-25 becomes available. No other >=25% single-day unlock found. Sources: https://orderly.network/docs/introduction/tokenomics/distribution-and-emission-schedule (primary), https://coinspeaker.com/orderly-network-tge-schedule-airdrop (news), https://app.tokenomics.com/tokenomics/orderly-network/unlocks (aggregator), https://www.coingecko.com/research/publications/coingecko-orderly-report (aggregator), https://defillama.com/unlocks/orderly (aggregator).

name: Rootstock Infrastructure Framework
gap: Poorly documented older token. No fetched page gives the token genesis/TGE date (yellow.com dates only the Rootstock beta mainnet, January 2018) or any per-allocation cliff or vesting terms. The first insider unlock date is therefore unknown (null). It is probably long before the 2023-05-01 window, given the 2018 private sale, but that is unconfirmed, so inWindow is null. A large RIF Labs Promotion batch may therefore have landed in 2023, possibly inside the window.
